source: Dubai property prices and rental yields by area (Kaggle: datahabibi/dubai-property-prices-and-rental-yields-by-area)
provenance: Third-party dataset with UNSTATED origin. Validated structurally: median gross yield 5.72% matches published Dubai norms, luxury areas correctly yield lowest, and price-vs-yield correlation is negative (r=-0.33). Treat as indicative, not authoritative.
note: Areas with gross yield above 12% excluded as implausible (3 of 92).
label: Median annual rent (AED)
method: Derived per area as median sale price x gross yield; the Dubai-wide figure is the median across areas.
